mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors shift capital from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5 percentage point increase in unemployment rate over two months signals economic deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 2 months but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales exceeding 0.5% in one month indicate weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as recession risks rise.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in 1 month but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY) triggers Federal Reserve tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as higher rates reduce equity valuations.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 100 (index) signals expanding economic activity, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 100 but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly nonfarm payrolls below 100,000 new jobs signal labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as economic growth concerns intensify.
failure_condition: PAYEMS < 100.0 but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such months.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent quarterly GDP decline and housing starts drop exceeding 1.0% signal economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as recession fears dominate.
failure_condition: GDPC1 QoQ < -1.0% and HOUST MoM < -1.0% but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales growth above 0.5% month-over-month indicates robust consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings are supported.
failure_condition: RSAFS > 0.5% MoM but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such months.
